note: DEC (Adirondack), on Dark Bay of Paradox Lake; boat launch, canoe and rowboat rentals; ~5 waterfront sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $18 + $5 non-resident and 1-night reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), phone 518-532-7451, opens May 14 2027 (matches). Season closes 09-05 added (2027 schedule ends Sun Sep 5, Labor Day weekend; DEC 2026: Sept 7); the existing manual season note kept. ReserveAmerica booking (now verified), 9-month window, 14-night max; 58 sites to 40 ft, all back-in; no electric; showers, flush toilets, dump, drinking water. Note trimmed of site/hookup/facility/booking text and 'large rigs fit' (only 13 of 55 listed sites are 30 ft or more).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: ReserveAmerica says the campground is 'located on the shore of Dark Bay, which is on Paradox Lake', and the note counts ~5 waterfront sites; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
Minor: of 55 bookable sites only 13 are listed at 30 ft or more (1 at 40, 12 at 30); 28 are listed at 20 ft and 15 have no length, so a 23-ft rig must pick its site.
